outline:
Objectives:
This course covers the principles of embedded and embedded operating systems inherent in many hardware platforms and applications being developed for engineering and science as well as for ubiquitous systems, including robotics and manufacturing, interactive and multimedia, immersive and omnipresent applications. As part of this course, students will learn about embedded system principles, understand embedded processor, embedded OS and real-time operating systems and the resource management issues that arise, and design sample applications on representative platforms.

Course Outline:

1. Embedded Computing — Introduction, Embedded System-on-Chip (SoC), Design Process
2. Embedded Hardware: Embedded Processors, Embedded Computing Platform
3. Program Design and Analysis
4. Embedded Software: Boot Loader, Device Drivers, Embedded OS, Middleware and Application Software
5. Hardware Accelerators
6. Network-Aware Systems
7. System Design Techniques
